verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser-agent and web-extraction platform, so large-table extraction is a fair axis for it. The evidence covers only general data pulling, URL-to-JSON/markdown conversion, and processing downloaded spreadsheets. Nothing documents intelligent chunking of very large tables to fit processing limits.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract data from very large tables using intelligent chunking so it fits within processing limits
